messages:
Sara (Sales): quick heads-up — Acme POC kickoff. they sent traffic profile and security questionnaire. main ask: guaranteed 99th pct latency under 350ms for chat, plus batch embedding jobs at night. can ops + runtime confirm an approach for reserved vs burst + autoscale?

Nina (Solutions): TL;DR: they want predictable tail latency during business hours, but want credits for burstable load. also require VPC peering + KMS. i attached the questionnaire in the doc (see link).

Kevin (SRE): noted. for VPC peering + KMS we can support via Private deploy or Dedicated with VPC peering + customer-managed KMS. will need an IP allowlist and egress rules.

Liam (Runtime): quick sizing sketch based on their profile: steady chat 250 qps, 99th pct latency target 350ms, bursts up to 1.2k qps for ~20m windows, nightly embedding 50k items over 3 hours.

Liam (Runtime): rough capacity draft (feel free to poke):
```
- model: rwd-3b-q8 (quantized) for chat (low-latency variant)
- baseline: 3 x A100-40 reserved (for sustained 250 qps at target latency)
- burst: 2 additional GPUs in burst pool (prewarmed) to hit 1.2k qps spikes
- embeddings: small batch jobs can run on shared spot pool overnight (2 x V100 spot slots)
- autoscale policy: concurrency-based + tail-hedge: scale-up when avg queue > 50ms or cpu/gpu util > 70%
```

Julie (Ops): pricing note — reserved GPUs: commit-monthly pricing sheet applies; burst GPU credits can be pre-purchased or metered. i'll flag commercial for exact numbers. from ops POV we need a preheat window (15m) for warm KV cache before business hours.

Sara (Sales): @Julie can you confirm whether preheat counts against reserved commit or is part of burst credits? client asks to avoid extra bill surprises.

Julie (Ops): preheat while reserved capacity exists is included; if we use burst pool those are billed as burst credits. we can structure the contract to include a monthly burst credit allocation.

Nina (Solutions): security Q: they require audit logs for model access and key rotation records. Kevin, do we have audit hooks available for Dedicated/Private?

Kevin (SRE): yes — Dedicated exposes audit logs to customer's CloudWatch/Stackdriver; Private supports pushing logs to their SIEM. KMS key rotation logs available via KMS audit. need a short runbook to show them.

Liam (Runtime): operational runbook highlights i recommend we share in POC:
- preheat steps: warm KV cache using representative prompts (script included)
- autoscale thresholds + cooldowns: escalate at 70% util, cooldown 5min, max scale 5x baseline
- fallback: if burst exhausted, use smaller model variant (rwd-1.3b) automatically
- monitoring: 99/95/50th latency dashboards + token-level cost per route

Liam (Runtime): snippet for preheat script to warm KV cache:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
for prompt in $(cat preheat_prompts.txt); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-q8","input":"'$prompt'","max_tokens":32}' >/dev/null &

done
wait
```

Sara (Sales): perfect — i'll send those runbook bullets to Acme and ask for times to run a preheat rehearsal. also sending the security answers.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: Dedicated pool reservation created: reservation-id rsv-420-77. please confirm preheat window.

Kevin (SRE): confirmed reservation rsv-420-77. ops, schedule preheat 09:15 local on deployment day; we'll monitor 99th pct and KV hit rate.

Julie (Ops): i'll add contract clause for burst credits and include a scheduled preheat window. commercial will confirm numbers, pinging @Sara when they have quotes.

Nina (Solutions): one last ask — client asked about model fallback quality impact. we should prepare a short eval report showing model A vs fallback model B on their prompt set.

Liam (Runtime): can do — send me 200 sample prompts and i'll run local eval overnight and paste results tomorrow morning.

Sara (Sales): thanks all — next steps: (1) Julie to confirm billing language for burst credits, (2) Liam to run eval on sample prompts, (3) Kevin to prepare runbook + network checklist, (4) Sara to share runbook + answers with Acme and schedule preheat rehearsal.

Sara (Sales): tagging this thread resolved for now, will reopen if Acme pushes changes. :thumbsup:
